readings.title: Attention Is All You Need
readings.summaryEn: Follow encoder and decoder tokens through attention, compute the key equation, then read translation tests, ablations, and parsing transfer.
readings.summaryZh: 沿编码器与解码器追踪 token，算清注意力公式，再读翻译实验、消融和句法分析。

readings.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
readings.summaryEn: Separate prefill computation, runtime global KV, and persistent KV; inspect CED and CSA2 with original figures, then read agent benchmarks with their harness conditions.
readings.summaryZh: 分清预填充计算、运行时全局 KV 和持久化 KV，结合原论文图读 CED、CSA2 和 Agent 评测。

readings.title: MiMo-V2.6
readings.summaryEn: Follow the training path through the RL objective, GRS/GAR grading, runtime system, MOPD2, and experiments.
readings.summaryZh: 从训练主线读到 RL 目标、GRS/GAR、运行系统、MOPD2 与实验。

readings.title: RAFT
readings.summaryEn: See how data refinement and answer-conditioned on-policy distillation work together, then inspect the domain-versus-general-capability evidence.
readings.summaryZh: 沿数据精炼与答案条件在线蒸馏的耦合路径，读懂领域能力和通用能力的实验权衡。

readings.title: MechVQA
readings.summaryEn: Trace how expert-verified mechanical drawings become a ten-task benchmark, then follow MechVL's SFT and RL training ladder and read its ablations.
readings.summaryZh: 沿专家核验的机械图纸到十类任务的基准构建流程，理解 MechVL 的 SFT 与 RL 训练阶梯及消融。

readings.title: IAR
readings.summaryEn: Follow Inject → Align → Recover from document exposure to retrieval-free QA, and compare domain gains with general-ability recovery across eight settings.
readings.summaryZh: 沿 Inject → Align → Recover 读懂文档知识注入、无检索问答与通用能力恢复，再对照八种设置下的证据。

readings.title: VISTA
readings.summaryEn: Follow the visual harness from lossless visual memory and model-directed inspection to a perfect ARC-AGI-3 score, then read the harness ablation ladder and cross-benchmark evidence.
readings.summaryZh: 沿无损视觉记忆与主动检视读懂视觉外骨架，再读 ARC-AGI-3 满分、harness 消融阶梯与跨基准证据。

readings.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 中文
readings.summaryEn: A Chinese reading of the KV-cache compression report: three deployment costs, the CED/CSA2/FP4/SWA-Bounded-Replay trade-offs, and the reasoning-effort knob with its evidence chain. Same source PDF as the English reading above.
readings.summaryZh: KV 缓存压缩报告的中文导读：三类部署成本、CED/CSA2/FP4/有界重放的取舍，以及带完整证据链的推理力度旋钮。与上方英文导读同一份源 PDF。

readings.title: OpenDS-World
readings.summaryEn: Trace the benchmark pipeline from audiovisual anchors through open-web evidence expansion and question inversion to human calibration, then read the 12-model evaluation and the cost/termination/failure analyses.
readings.summaryZh: 沿"视频锚点→开放网页证据扩展→问题反演→人工验证与实测标定"读懂基准构建，再读 12 模型统一评测与成本、终止、失败恢复分析。

readings.title: OmniDR-Bench
readings.summaryEn: Follow the video-centered research task and seven-stage workflow, then read how ARC builds audited rubric trees and what 18 agent configurations fail on: presentation near 82 while content and citation stay under 48.
readings.summaryZh: 沿"视频为锚点的研究报告任务 + 七阶段工作流"读懂基准，再看 ARC 审计式判据构建与 18 个配置的评测：呈现近 82 分而内容与引用不足 48 分。

readings.title: LoRA
readings.summaryEn: Change an input and trace the low-rank correction through both branches and merged weights. Work from initialization gradients to a two-dimensional subspace example, then inspect the evidence. Four understanding checks, including a new-budget transfer task.
readings.summaryZh: 改变输入，跟算低秩修正，再核对合并权重的输出。从初始化梯度读到二维子空间例子，完整实验与协议按需展开。附四道自测，包含换预算的迁移题。

readings.title: Deep Residual Learning / ResNet
readings.summaryEn: Calculate the original block's forward and backward passes, separate training degradation from generalization, and trace an appendix detection improvement. Five understanding checks, including an altered-shortcut transfer task.
readings.summaryZh: 先算原始残差块的前向和反传，区分训练退化与泛化，再追踪附录检测框修正的完整操作；附五道自测，包含改变 shortcut 的迁移题。

readings.title: Dual Exam
readings.summaryEn: Read the 0%-success coupled pilot, then follow the two controlled tracks: fixed environment responses for Agents (10 configurations, 1,088 items) and fixed action interventions for World Models (400 cases), with explicit aggregation rules and a candid limitations section.
readings.summaryZh: 从 150 例耦合试点 0% 成功率出发，读懂双轨受控评测：固定环境响应考 Agent（10 配置 1088 题）、固定动作干预考世界模型（400 例），以及论文对自身评测局限的罕见坦白。

readings.title: Trustworthy RSI Survey
readings.summaryEn: A survey reading of trustworthy recursive self-improvement: the h/B/U definition, the S1–S4/RI stage lens, four trustworthiness themes under three analytical roles, and the evidence funnel from 26 RSI-labeled claims to 4 matched-budget comparisons.
readings.summaryZh: 可信递归自我改进综述导读：h/B/U 三层操作化定义、S1–S4/RI 五阶段透镜、四主题×三角色框架，以及 26 项 RSI 声称只剩 4 项等预算对照的证据漏斗。

readings.title: The Trinity
readings.summaryEn: A method reading of capability-driven recursive self-improvement for multimodal agents: task→capability→harness trees, selective inheritance, Real2Sim2Real with a screening band, and a router reaching ~96% of Oracle.
readings.summaryZh: 能力驱动的多模态 Agent RSI 方法导读：任务→能力→Harness 三棵树、选择性继承⊕、带表现带筛选的 Real2Sim2Real、逼近 Oracle 的能力感知路由。

readings.title: Rollback
readings.summaryEn: A 16-chapter Deep Reading of experience-backtracking search: reconstruct PUCT, relative value bins, flow matching, model adaptation, and asynchronous training, then examine real-robot experiments and appendices A–G.
readings.summaryZh: 16 章 Deep Reading：逐步重建回退搜索、PUCT、相对价值分档、flow matching、模型适配与异步训练，再逐组核对真机实验、消融及附录 A–G。

readings.title: LongZero
readings.summaryEn: A Deep Reading of zero-data long-context RL: the policy writes a compact question-evidence-answer specification before expanding it into long documents, filters to the unstable band, and trains with GRPO, beating external-corpus and 397B-teacher synthetic data on five benchmarks.
readings.summaryZh: 零数据长上下文 RL 深读：策略先写紧凑的问题-证据-答案规格再展开成长文档，不稳定带过滤后 GRPO 训练，五基准胜过外部语料与 397B 教师合成数据。

readings.title: HarnessPro
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 17 chapters) of Pareto-aware recursive harness self-improvement: fixed LLM-generated tests, DPP coreset, three-priority planning, tiered selection; appendices B-D fully integrated; beating RHO at 26.1% lower cost with denominator recomputation.
readings.summaryZh: 帕累托感知的 Harness 递归自我改进深读（量化深度版，9000+字/17章/26小节/13公式/7手算）：固定 LLM 生成测试（检出 41.7%→83.3%）、DPP coreset、三优先级计划、加权平方距离选三档；附录 B/C/D 全量整合；全面超 RHO 且成本降 26.1%。

readings.title: A-RSI
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 12 chapters, 20 subsections, 11 display equations, 11 worked calcs) of adaptive task refresh for zero-data multimodal self-improvement: training-log pool saturation detection, shared-configuration programmatic tasks, five-arm matched-update comparison, reward stress tests, and output decomposition.
readings.summaryZh: 零数据多模态自我改进的自适应任务刷新深读（量化深度版 9000+字）：训练日志触发的池饱和检测、共享配置契约程序化出题、五臂对照逐格重算、奖励压力测试与输出分解（完成 vs 改正）。

readings.title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 27 subsections, 23 display equations, 17 worked calcs) of causal action identification in world action models: over-coverage lower bound (Prop 1), support-sparsity identifiability (Thm 1-2 with full proof chains), sparse token routing on Cosmos 3 Nano, block-recovery synthetic audit, and 17-task macro recomputation (0.24 to 0.43).
readings.summaryZh: 世界动作模型的因果动作辨识深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/23公式/17手算）：过覆盖下界（Prop 1）、支撑稀疏可识别性（Thm 1-2 证明链全展开）、Cosmos 3 Nano 上的稀疏 token 路由、合成块恢复审计与 17 任务宏平均重算（0.24→0.43）。

readings.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 17 subsections, 11 display equations, 14 worked calcs) of nested double-loop recursive improvement for computer-use agents: open-world video seeding with visual-semantic dual-path reconstruction, primitive-based K/N composable task synthesis, snapshot-rollback retry, plus full recomputation of Table 1 efficiency claims and domain-table denominator audits (two tables fail to reconstruct).
readings.summaryZh: 计算机使用 Agent 的开放世界递归自我改进深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/11公式/14手算）：双环飞轮（世界-数据-模型外环+播种/自催化内环）、视觉-语义双路轨迹重建、K/N 预算的原语组合合成、快照回滚重试，Table 1 效率声明逐条复算与域表分母审计（两张表重构不上）。

readings.title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 20 subsections, 10 display equations, 26 worked calcs) of the deliberately simple three-stage recipe (2xSFT + RL, no mid-training/DPO/OPD) for open agent foundation models: model-aware four-operator difficulty enhancement, deterministic filter-select-compute-verbalize task construction, prefix-chain partial rewards, TITO/R3 training-inference consistency, plus full recomputation of Tables 1-3 and R3 diagnostics.
readings.summaryZh: 开源 Agent 基座极简配方深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/10公式/26手算）：两段 SFT+RL 三段式（无中途训练/DPO/OPD）、模型感知四难化算子、确定性 filter-select-compute-verbalize 造题、前缀链部分奖励、TITO/R3 训推一致性，Table 1-3 与 R3 诊断逐格复算。

readings.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 22 subsections, 10 display equations, 12 worked calcs) of what multi-turn agentic RL actually improves: Pass@K boundary expansion vs Pass@T budget dependence (reversal -11.3 at 25% budget), step-level quality slightly declining on matched states while error-state recovery reverses (65.7-67.3%), likelihood mechanism (NLL overlap, trajectory LLR 228 vs 26), and BudgetMix RL repair (+7.9/+5.2/+3.8/+1.1 across budget tiers) with step-quality erosion eliminated.
readings.summaryZh: 多轮 Agent RL 归因分析深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/10公式/12手算）：Pass@K 扩边界 vs Pass@T 预算依赖（25% 预算反转 -11.3）、匹配态步级质量不升反微降而错误态反转（65.7-67.3%）、似然机制（NLL 重叠、轨迹 LLR 228 对 26）、BudgetMix 修复（紧档 +7.9 到满档 +1.1，步级侵蚀归零）。

readings.title: Claude｜Building agents：何时把子代理折进主循环
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 14 subsections, 10 display formulas, 17 worked calcs) of Anthropic's official guidance on folding subagents into the main agent loop: five enterprise failure modes with interface-count squaring, three keep-conditions as a decision rule, telephone-game fidelity and nested-loop latency models reproducing the 2x claim, progressive-disclosure budget matching the 80% prompt cut, and the eval-first migration path with task-flip analysis.
readings.summaryZh: Anthropic 官方「子代理折叠」指南深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/10公式/17手算）：五大企业失败模式（接口数平方律）、三保留条件决策规则、电话游戏保真度与嵌套延迟模型（复算 2 倍声明）、渐进披露预算（对上 80% 缩减）、评测先行迁移路径与 task-flip 分析。

readings.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 19 subsections, 9 display equations, 14 worked calcs) of the Drex family of four open decision models: choice/noul/score interface, pointer vs readout heads, RLAF training (verified outcome + same-backbone judge under KL anchor, closed-form optimum), Decision Index 0.4.1 SOTA 67.52 with 183ms latency, calibration and flip-rate analyses, and deployment engineering.
readings.summaryZh: 决策模型家族 Drex 深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/9公式/14手算）：choice/noul/score 接口、指针/读出双头、RLAF 训练（验证结果+同基座裁判+KL 锚定）、DI 0.4.1 SOTA 67.52 与 183ms 延迟、校准与翻转率全量分析、部署工程账。

readings.title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 18 subsections, 19 worked calcs) of NVIDIA's AgentBaton: direction asymmetry in model handoffs (capable-to-efficient wins), three readiness signals, a 2B learned detector (338ms median), saving 65.9% API cost across 11 model pairs while extending the Pareto frontier.
readings.summaryZh: 模型交接的效率深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/19手算）：方向不对称（强→轻才划算）、三就绪信号（工件+反馈+剩余局部化）、2B 检测器（338ms）、65.9% API 省钱、帕累托前沿推扫。

readings.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9k+ chars, 16 chapters, 18 subsections, 10 display equations, 24 worked calcs) of Google DeepMind's four Gemini 4 Argon agents beating Minecraft end-to-end: program-generation interface (2,783 programs, 63K lines JS), emergent coordination (roles in 10 min, Ghast loss-to-rule in 2 min), stronghold triangulation at 43m accuracy (independently recomputed), despawn-timer rescue with 2.5-min margin, dragon state-machine reverse engineering, and $520 cost breakdown with 91% cache economics.
readings.summaryZh: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon agent 通关 Minecraft 深读（量化深度版 9000+字/16章/10公式/24手算）：程序生成接口（2783 程序/63K 行 JS）、涌现协作（10 分钟分工、Ghast 损失→规则 2 分钟闭环）、三角定位 43m 精度独立复算、despawn 极限救援 2.5 分钟余量、龙的状态机逆向、$520 成本分解与 91% 缓存经济学。

readings.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9,003 chars, 24 sections, 12 display equations, 6 worked calcs) of Flide, an exact inference engine for decision models: flattening each round of requests into one token stream with tree structure in GPU-resident metadata, ForkAttention forking both attention (visibility indices) and Gated DeltaNet states (two-call restart from trunk state), flat CUDA graph families whose shape depends only on stream length, incremental checkpoints for growing agent histories, and an optional bitwise-invariant mode. Up to 9.5x faster than vLLM/SGLang with highest agreement to the float32 reference; MIS delimiter corruption independently recomputed (13.3x TV, up to 28.9% flipped decisions); serves 29 decision models incl. Drex v1.5.
readings.summaryZh: 决策模型推理引擎 Flide 深读（量化深度版 9,003字/24节/12公式/6手算）：逻辑树压进扁平流、树结构住 GPU 元数据；ForkAttention 全注意力可见性下标 + GDN 两次调用从躯干状态重启；CUDA 图族形状只依赖流长；agent 历史增量检查点；可选位级确定模式。最快 9.5 倍于 vLLM/SGLang 且与 float32 参考一致率最高；MIS 分隔符污染独立复算（TV 13.3 倍、翻转最多 28.9%）；已服务 29 个决策模型含上周深读的 Drex v1.5。

readings.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
readings.summaryEn: A quantitative-depth Deep Reading (9,006 chars, 23 sections, 11 display equations, 5 worked calcs) of MMDM, a 5,448-question benchmark across 16 task categories for System-1 decision models: options 2-1,024, inputs to 64,817 tokens, single-select/multi-select/soft-label tracks, 28 models evaluated. Key decoupling findings independently recomputed: KnowLine vs WeMM-JEV single-select gap <1pp but Brier halved; best multi-select only 36.81% with all SB-F <0.2; OpenJev vs Intern-4B ranking reverses between long-input and large-option axes; SB-F worked examples and case-study Brier recomputation.
readings.summaryZh: 决策模型大规模评测基准 MMDM 深读（量化深度版 9,006字/23节/11公式/5手算）：5,448 题/16 类/选项至 1,024/输入至 64K，单选-多选-软标签三轨评测 28 个决策模型。解耦发现独立复算：单选差不到 1 点的两个模型 Brier 差近一半；多选最高 36.81%、SB-F 全部 <0.2（认得出一个丢得掉一群）；长输入与大选项两轴排名反转；SB-F 教学例与案例 Brier 手算。决策模型三部曲收官（Drex 模型侧→Flide 服务侧→MMDM 评测侧）。
